title: Nested Sparsity for Scalable Pretraining and Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.31818v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) transformers, the standard backbone for modern large-scale deep learning, employ conditional computation: only a sparse subset of model weights is used in each forward pass. In MoE transformers, this sparsity arises in the MoE operator, which generalizes the multi-layer perceptron in the classical transformer. In this work, we explore an alternative mechanism for conditional computation that analogously generalizes the attention operator. The sparsity induced by this mechanism naturally nests (i.e., hierarchically composes) with the sparsity induced by the MoE operator. We show that a transformer employing this nested sparsity mechanism, which we call Nestor, performs better than a conventional MoE transformer at equal compute and equal sparsity in language model pretraining. We also show that Nestor is well-suited for continual pretraining: it can be adapted to longer contexts more effectively than conventional

translated_title: 面向可扩展预训练与持续学习的嵌套稀疏性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.31818v1 公告类型：新 摘要：混合专家transformer是现代大规模深度学习的标准骨干架构，其采用条件计算：每次前向传播中仅使用模型权重的一个稀疏子集。在 MoE transformer 中，这种稀疏性来自 MoE 算子，该算子是对经典 transformer 中多层感知机的推广。在本工作中，我们探索了一种替代性的条件计算机制，它以类似的方式推广了注意力算子。由该机制诱导的稀疏性能够与 MoE 算子诱导的稀疏性自然地嵌套（即进行层级组合）。我们展示了采用这种嵌套稀疏性机制的 transformer（我们将其命名为 Nestor），在相同计算量和相同稀疏度下，在语言模型预训练中的表现优于传统的 MoE transformer。我们还展示了 Nestor 非常适合持续预训练：相比传统方法，它能够更有效地适配更长的上下文。
tldr: 本文提出 Nestor，一种推广注意力算子的嵌套稀疏机制，可与 MoE 稀疏性层级组合，在相同计算量和稀疏度下预训练性能优于传统 MoE transformer，并能更有效地进行持续预训练和适配更长上下文。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Nestor, a nested sparsity mechanism that generalizes the attention operator and hierarchically composes with MoE sparsity, outperforming conventional MoE transformers in pretraining at equal compute and sparsity while enabling more effective continual pretraining and adaptation to longer contexts.
